description: Encode and decode HTML entities (named, decimal, hex). Operations: "encode" — Encode text into HTML entities.; "decode" — Decode HTML entities back to plain text.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: encode: The text to encode. decode: The text containing HTML entities.

operation.description: encode — Encode text into HTML entities. decode — Decode HTML entities back to plain text.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

encodeAll.description: Encode every character. Used by: encode.

format.description: Output entity format. Used by: encode.

preferNamed.description: Prefer a named entity when one exists. Used by: encode.

name: html-entity
title: HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder
